subject: general
question: Pandit Swapan Chaudhuri is associated with ___________ instrument.
solution:
The correct answer is __**tabla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Swapan **Chaudhuri is an **Indian tabla player**.
 
• He was born on 1947 in Kolkata.
 
• He was awarded **Padma Shri**, **Sangeet Natak Akademi **Award for **Hindustani Music - Instrumental (Tabla).**
 
• He received the American Academy of Artists Award and was nominated to the Percussive Arts Society Hall of Fame. In 1996, Swapan Chaudhuri received the Sangeet Natak Academy Award from the President of India, the highest award for Classical Music in India. In 2019, he received the Padma Shri, one of India's highest honours from the Indian government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **veena **also **spelt vina**, comprises various **chordophone instruments **from the **Indian subcontinent**.
 
• **Harmonium **is a **stringed instrument **made of **wood, metal, brass, and cloth**. A kind of **portable wooden box**, it **originated **in **West Bengal.**
 
• **A bansuri **is an ancient **side-blown flute **originating from the **Indian subcontinent**. It is an **aerophone **produced **from bamboo** and used in **Hindustani classical music**.
